prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: transparent RGBA ocean impact splash sprite atlas for a real-time 3D stormy island scene.
Create ONE square atlas divided into an exact 2 by 2 equal grid, containing four DIFFERENT isolated realistic ocean splash cutouts, one fully contained in each quadrant, on genuinely transparent background. Each quadrant has generous completely transparent padding of at least 10% on all four sides. No borders or grid lines.
Top-left: a wide dense breaking surf plume thrown upward by striking coastal rock, irregular scalloped water crown, many fine entrained droplets, small foamy opaque lower core fading into translucent wisps above.
Top-right: a lopsided torn sheet of seawater collapsing outward after a coastal impact, irregular curved fingers and holes, interrupted rim, photorealistic small droplets trailing to one side.
Bottom-left: a soft drifting sea spray cloud with delicate translucent water mist and sparse individual droplets, irregular broken silhouette, airy and not dense smoke.
Bottom-right: scattered fine seawater fragments and droplets from a breaking wave, varied natural sizes and elongated falling droplets, loosely clustered, mostly transparent.
View: eye-level telephoto high-shutter-speed natural photograph of water only, nearly frontal, readable silhouette. Diffuse neutral overcast illumination, grey-white aerated water with subtle internal grey shading, no glowing white, no strong blue cast. Maintain detailed semitransparent spray alpha and empty holes.
Constraints: water only; NO ocean surface, horizon, rocks, island, background, shadow, floor, text, frame, icons, arrows, checkerboard pattern, repeated lines, regular stripes, fireworks, smoke, clouds or cartoon shapes. All four sprites independent and never touch another cell. Actual transparent alpha background.
